businessGoal: Enable users to navigate through multiple pages of products efficiently.

scenarios.goal: Verify that pagination controls are displayed when there are more products than fit on one page.
Verify that clicking a page number updates the product grid to show products for that page.
Ensure that the current page number is visually highlighted after navigating.

manual.reason: The story includes user interaction with pagination controls and visual changes.

api.reason: The story does not involve any API interaction or validation through APIs.

ui.reason: The story involves visible browser behavior related to pagination controls and product display.
